test_DDIMScheduler_config: test DDIMScheduler with different beta_start, beta_end, and beta_schedule configurations
test_DDIMScheduler_timesteps: test DDIMScheduler set_timesteps with various num_inference_steps and steps_offset values
test_DDIMScheduler_variance: test DDIMScheduler _get_variance method with different timestep pairs for numerical correctness
